description: Change of use and conversion of the vacant office building (Class E(g)(i)) to provide 19 dwellings (Class C3) comprising 2 x 1b/2p, 3 x 2b/3p, 10 x 2b/4p, 3 x 3b/5p and 1 x 3b/6p, including external alterations comprising replacement of the third floor dormer roof with a flat-roofed recessed façade, installation of rooflights, roof-mounted plant enclosure and photovoltaic panels; erection of a single-storey mews office building (Class E(g)(i)) to the rear providing 243 sqm (GIA) of floorspace arranged as up to five units; together with associated refuse and cycle storage, car parking, landscaping and associated works.
decision_conditions:
Open space assessment
-Analysis of existing open space provision in line with the Council’s accessibility standards; and
-Provision of new on-site open space in areas of Public Open Space deficiency (shown on the policies map).
